title: The Electricity Act, 2003
verified_how: Fetched a Wayback copy (18 Feb 2025) of the India Code PDF bitstream/123456789/15367/1/the_electricity_act,_2003.pdf. It shows 'THE ELECTRICITY ACT, 2003' and 'ACT NO. 36 OF 2003'.
